articles.title: Landspace tests 220-ton methane engine for future heavy-lift launchers
articles.summary:
Chinese launch startup Landspace says it has completed a long-duration full-system hot-fire test of its new 220-ton-class methane rocket engine for new-generation launchers.

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch direct television satellite for EchoStar
articles.summary: The launch of the EchoStar 25 satellite is SpaceX’s first launch to a geosynchronous transfer orbit so far this year. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for 11:19 p.m. EDT (0319 UTC).
